blocks.text: One unifying call to every believer is the ministry of reconciliation, regardless of your call or ministry, gift or talent every member of the body of Christ has a primary duty to bring sinners to the knowledge of Christ and accept Him as Lord and Saviour. {{2co 5:18|2 Cor. 5:18}} says "And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ and hath given us the ministry of reconciliation". This is why our Lord Jesus Christ gave a command (call) in {{mk 16:15|Mark 16:15}} "..., go ye into the world and preach the gospel to every creation" Therefore, all other activities in the ministry must complement (go along with) the ministry of reconciliation ({{1co 9:16|1Cor 9:16}}). Souls must first be reconciled to Christ before they can be called into ministry.

SPECIALLY CHOSEN TO BEAR FRUIT A worker is one who has been chosen and advanced for a special purpose, which is fruit bearing- {{jo 15:16|Jn. 15: 16}}. He is a sanctified consecrated worker for this divine assignment. His choice qualifies him particularly to bear at best two categories of fruits. (1) The fruit of the Spirit - Gal.5: 22-23. (2) The fruit of soul winning- {{prv 11:30|Prov. 11:30}}, {{ez 33:7,ez 33:8,ez 33:9|Ezek. 33: 7-9}}. In order to bear fruits that will abide, a worker must first abide in Christ- {{jo 15:5,jo 15:16|Jn. 15: 5, 16}}.

EVANGELISM & MISSIONS There is the urgent need for aggressive evangelism and mission outreaches because the harvest is plenty but the labourers are few-{{mt 9:37,mt 9:38|Mt 9:37-38}}. Evangelism and missions are not optional for every Christian worker because: (1) It is God's desire that the light of the gospel should cover the whole world - {{gn 1:2,gn 1:3|Gen 1:2-3}}, {{is 60:19|Isa 60:19}}, {{nm 14:21|Num 14:21}}

items: God has chosen us to be the means by which He will shine His light and glory to the whole world - {{mt 5:14,mt 5:15,mt 5:16|Mt 5: 14-16}}.
We are to go all over the world to preach His word and make disciples.
We are to help those who want to go and preach all over the world by sending clothes, books, materials, food and money to the missionaries.
We are to fervently pray for the missionaries and all those people who do not yet know Christ.
